svg.text: Starting in order, coming back to life by itself
Concept 8 · depends_on + health checks set the order of up -d; the restart policy decides who comes back
The docker compose up -d timeline in the author's lab
cupboards already full, images already there · number = bar end (seconds on Compose's screen, Pi 5) · bar start inferred from depends_on
waits: db healthy, migrate done, mosquitto started
docker compose up -d --wait waits until everything is healthy (Grafana too) before the prompt comes back: lab 25.6 s, Grafana healthy last (23.1 s).
Without the service_healthy condition, migrate starts 0.3 s after db and fails: ECONNREFUSED, exit 1 (the author's research test).
the healthcheck is only for the order, ps,
the broker or the DB is cut off: a real
the next up: "broker password file already
Who comes back to life by itself?
Syllabus: "stopping one container and watching it come back to life by itself" (Practice 8)
a crash: the program exits with
* Docker tries again with a longer and longer pause (up to 1 minute). kill 1 from inside imitates a program that stops by itself, not a crash.
After docker compose down nothing comes back (its containers are gone). A sleeping laptop = everything sleeps; running 24 hours = Module 27.
